## SK Hynix Unveils Open HBF Standard to Shape AI Memory Interconnect Architecture

Proposing an open interconnect standard is a classic ecosystem-capture move — if adopted, it would entrench SK Hynix's architectural influence beyond HBM supply, creating a durable moat that is harder to displace on specs alone and complicating the competitive calculus for Samsung and Micron.

- SK Hynix has introduced the Open HBF (High Bandwidth Fabric) standard, targeting AI systems.
- The move positions SK Hynix as a standards-setter in AI memory interconnect architecture, not merely a component supplier.
- An open standard could reshape competitive dynamics in AI compute topology and memory connectivity.
- No adoption commitments or ecosystem partners are named in the headline.
